Rapid tests for antimicrobial resistance are needed to optimize treatment for bacterial infections. A combination of the MTT test and Raman spectroscopy can provide a 1.5-h test for antimicrobial susceptibility, requiring 10 6 –10 8 CFU/mL of bacteria. …

Herein, we employ Raman hydration-shell spectroscopy in the OH stretch region to investigate B12X122– in aqueous solution. Specifically, we elucidate (i) the water structure in the hydration shell, (ii) its temperature dependence, and (iii) the water release upon superchaotropic binding. The hydration-shell spectra reveal that all dodecaborates give rise to a sharp Raman band close to 3600 cm–1. …
